Game Overview

Zombie Siege is a zombie title where face relentless zombie hordes as the last defender of your city in Zombie Siege. With immersive pixel-art graphics, engage in thrilling gunfights and navigate each intensifying wave. Stay vigilant, use strategic resources wisely, and prevent the undead from breaching the city center in this gripping retro survival challenge.
